column2: WARNING Bushing Terminal Support Sign – Unsupported Lead Can Fall – 8x12 Aluminum
column3:
Unsupported Lead Can Fall. This WARNING Bushing Terminal Support sign from CGAP Safety reads: BUSHING TERMINAL SUPPORT / UNSUPPORTED LEAD CAN FALL / ISOLATE AND VERIFY POWER OFF / SUPPORT LEAD BEFORE UNBOLTING. Written for Electric utility substations, power plants, industrial transformer yards.

Why this sign matters

When the terminal bolts are loosened, the unsupported heavy lead drops or swings and strikes the worker's hands or body below it. Any feed still energized adds a shock path.

Where to post it

Mount on the transformer cover beside the bushing terminal pad where the lead is unbolted.

Who orders it

Substation maintenance supervisors, relay and transformer techs.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards to review for your site: OSHA 1910.333; NFPA 70E; ANSI Z535.2. A sign supports your safety program; it does not replace guarding, lockout or training.

column2: WARNING Turbine Stud Tensioner Sign – Pressurized Tool Can Eject Parts – 8x12 Aluminum

Loose Cart Can Fall From Lift. This WARNING Laundry Cart Lift Retainer sign from CGAP Safety reads: LAUNDRY CART LIFT RETAINER / LOOSE CART CAN FALL FROM LIFT / VERIFY CART LOCK ENGAGED / BEFORE STARTING LIFT CYCLE. Written for Correctional laundries, institutional laundry rooms.

Why this sign matters

A cart that is not locked into the retainer can slide off the lift as it rises and fall onto the loader.

Where to post it

Fasten to the lift mast beside the cart retainer, at loading height.

Who orders it

Laundry supervisors.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards to review for your site: OSHA 1910.176; ANSI Z535.2. A sign supports your safety program; it does not replace guarding, lockout or training.
